MOTION_SUBTITLE: Every Motion preset and option. Tap Replay to run them again.
TEXT_EFFECTS_SUBTITLE: Every MotionText effect. Tap Replay to run them again.
TEXT_EFFECTS_GRADIENT_DESC: Colors sweep through the letters in a loop.
TEXT_EFFECTS_SHIMMER_DESC: A bright band passes over the text.
TEXT_EFFECTS_TYPING_DESC: One character at a time, with a cursor.
TEXT_EFFECTS_WORDS_DESC: Each word enters with a MotionView preset.
TEXT_EFFECTS_LETTERS_DESC: Letter by letter. Arabic text animates word by word to keep its letters joined.
TEXT_EFFECTS_COUNT_DESC: Counts up to a number, slowing down at the end.
BUTTON_EFFECTS_SUBTITLE: Wrap any Button with MotionButton to add animated layers. Press them to try.
BUTTON_EFFECTS_PUSHABLE_DESC: The button sits on a darker edge and sinks into it when pressed.
BUTTON_EFFECTS_SHINE_DESC: A soft light streak glides across every few seconds.
BUTTON_EFFECTS_GLOW_DESC: A colored glow behind the button breathes, and flares when pressed.
BUTTON_EFFECTS_BORDER_BEAM_DESC: A light beam runs around the border.
BUTTON_EFFECTS_SCALE_DESC: A slight spring shrink while pressed.
SKELETON_SUBTITLE: Placeholders that sketch the layout while data loads.
SKELETON_PROFILE_DESC: An avatar with a name and a caption.
SKELETON_CARD_DESC: An image, a title and a paragraph.
SKELETON_LIST_DESC: Repeat a row while a list loads.
SKELETON_PULSE_DESC: Fades in and out instead of a light sweep.
SKELETON_SWAP_DESC: Shows the skeleton for 2 seconds, then fades in the real content.
